elysium.command.respec: Every assigned point returned — %s to spend
elysium.favor.recognised: Favor: Recognised — the Unsworn are drawn to you
elysium.favor.unknown: The Empire does not know your name
elysium.screen.choose: Declare yourself. This is recorded once.
elysium.screen.standing_hint: Both are held by continuing to act, and bleed away when you stop. Below 25 the Empire is not watching either way.
elysium.stat.accuracy.desc: Chance to land a critical hit
elysium.stat.fortitude.desc: Armour you have without wearing any
elysium.stat.intellect.desc: Psionic potency: elemental advantage and rune strength
elysium.stat.luck.desc: Chance of more out of everything you kill
elysium.stat.presence.desc: How fast the Empire notices, and how well a reforge rolls
elysium.stat.reflexes.desc: Chance to avoid a blow outright
elysium.stat.resilience.desc: Cuts a share off everything that reaches you
elysium.stat.retribution.desc: Sends a share of every blow back at its owner
elysium.stat.strength.desc: Your base damage, before a weapon multiplies it
elysium.stat.vitality.desc: Passive health regeneration, and a little more of it to lose
elysium.tooltip.requires_level: Grants no bonus stats below character level %s
elysium.inspection.planted: An Imperial inspection post has been raised at %s, %s, %s. It reports for %s minutes.
elysium.screen.spend.desc: Spends one point. Permanent — points are not refunded, though /elysium respec returns them all at once.
elysium.screen.favor.desc: The Unsworn's regard. Raised by killing the Empire's sanctioned targets. Higher Favor brings more Unsworn after you and raises the TIER of what everything drops. Decays slowly when you stop earning it.
elysium.screen.suspicion.desc: The Empire's attention. Raised by mining, ascending gear, killing enforcers and claiming ground. Higher Suspicion brings more Imperial company and raises the AMOUNT everything drops — and past 50 it brings announced sieges against your claim.
elysium.tooltip.sockets_free: Socket runes at a Rune Socket Table. A rune of this piece's own element is worth %sx.
